Name: Mouth
Description: Create JaW and Lips System for Games

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Create JaW and Lips System for Games. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. SetAttrsPosition: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. TweakCtrlsAmount: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 7). MidCtrlsAmount: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 5). CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4). SetUpperEdge: set the node/object name this block should use. Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need. Template parent examples: Jaw_Jnt, Head_Jnt, Head_Ctrl. Template attrs-position examples: Lips_Center_Ctrl, Vis_Ctrl, Mouth_Jaw_Ctrl.
